info.title: QuestBoard API
info.description: Multi-game quests, progression, achievements, seasons and real-time leaderboards. Player/admin endpoints use Sanctum bearer tokens; game-server endpoints use X-Api-Key + HMAC (X-Timestamp, X-Signature). Errors are application/problem+json (RFC 7807).

get.summary: Cacheable list with a strong ETag (rarely changes)

delete.summary: GDPR-style account deletion: personal data is anonymized, gameplay history kept
